definitions.explanation: To write something down clearly and explicitly so there is no ambiguity. Used in formal, legal, and business contexts for information that must be recorded precisely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{氏名|しめい}→氏名：04033_shimei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明記|めいき}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please clearly write your address and name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{明記|めいき}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The conditions are clearly stated in the contract.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦{職種|しょくしゅ}→職種：13921_shokushu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明記|めいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧、⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送付|そうふ}→送付：07345_soufu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When applying, please send your resume with the desired position clearly noted.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru verb ({明記|めいき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) or noun. Very common in instructions on forms, contracts, and official documents. The pattern {明記|めいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧ means 'having clearly stated' and is standard in application instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明記|めいき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clearly state ~
- {明記|めいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧: having clearly noted (on documents)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{明記|めいき}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧: is clearly stated in ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{明示|めいじ}→明示：13031_meiji⟧: explicit indication (showing clearly, not necessarily in writing)
- ⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧: entry, description (writing down, less emphasis on clarity)
